info.title: Cancel or Delete a Video Generation Task
info.description: Cancel a queued video generation task, or delete a video generation task record.

delete.summary: Cancel or Delete a Video Generation Task
delete.description: Cancel a queued video generation task, or delete a video generation task record.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
The ID of the video generation task to cancel or delete.

The behavior of the DELETE endpoint varies by task status:

| Current Status | DELETE Supported | Behavior | Status After DELETE |
|---|---|---|---|
| queued | Yes | Cancel task queueing, task status changes to `cancelled` | cancelled |
| running | No | - | - |
| succeeded | Yes | Delete the video generation task record; subsequent queries will not be supported | - |
| failed | Yes | Delete the video generation task record; subsequent queries will not be supported | - |
| cancelled | No | - | - |
| expired | Yes | Delete the video generation task record; subsequent queries will not be supported | - |

> Note: The above parameters are Query String Parameters, passed in the URL string.

200.description: This API has no response parameters.

BearerAuth.description: Pass `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the request header.
